# Anycode v0.3.7

Anycode v0.3.7 adds an in-terminal search bar overlay powered by `@wterm/dom` search and implements native macOS `NSAlert` dialogs for `window.alert`, `window.confirm`, and `window.prompt` in the desktop app.

## Terminal

- **Terminal Search Overlay**: Added an interactive search bar overlay (`Cmd+F` / `Ctrl+F`) with `@wterm/dom` search integration, supporting case-sensitive matching (`Aa`), next/previous match navigation (`Enter` / `Shift+Enter` / arrow buttons), live match count indicators, and automatic prefill from single-line terminal selection.

## Desktop (macOS)

- **Native Alert, Confirm & Prompt Dialogs**: Implemented `WKUIDelegate` handlers backed by AppKit `NSAlert` and `NSTextField` in `anycode-desktop` on macOS so `window.alert()`, `window.confirm()`, and `window.prompt()` (such as creating or renaming files/folders and confirming deletions) work natively in WKWebView.

**Full comparison:** `v0.3.6...v0.3.7`
